messages:
maris: quick follow-up from the GPU postmortem. we mapped five remediation tasks: quota backstop, scheduler slow-start/hysteresis, nightly maintenance gating, emergency reserve auction, and degraded-routing telemetry. need owners + short deadlines.

devon: i'll take quota backstop + tenant-level soft limits. thinking: per-tenant "burst_tokens" = 12% for 90s then linear decay over 6m. RFC + config tests by 2026-04-05.

sylvie: i'll own scheduler slow-start and eviction damping. plan: run replays comparing coalesce=60/100/140ms, eviction_damping=3%->6%. measurement 48h, PR in 12 days.

harry: i'll draft the emergency reserve auction: keep 4% static reserve, allow ephemeral drawdown up to 10% with auctioning priority tokens. will include cost delta and alerting. draft by 2026-03-31.

maris: +1 on telemetry: we need a single fallback_event_id in usage logs plus a degraded_reason tag. who can add that?

harry: i'll add the telemetry schema change with a write to tenant_usage and a billing annotation. will include sample exports.

sylvie: for nightly maintenance (compaction/quant jobs) propose job-runner preflight: if global_headroom < 11% delay randomized 2-7m and report attempt_id. i'll coordinate with batch team; gating PR targeted 2026-04-02.

devon: decision: short-term (1-2w) = soft burst_tokens + compaction gating + small scheduler nudge; medium-term (3-6w) = eviction-damping PR + reserve auction + degraded routing.

ops-bot: Incident #6123 owners assigned (devon, sylvie, harry, maris).

maris: deadlines: quota RFC & tests due 2026-04-05; gating PR due 2026-04-02; scheduler measurements due 2026-03-29; reserve draft due 2026-03-31; telemetry PR due 2026-04-01.

sylvie: measurement targets: eviction_events down >=35%, p99 delta <8%. will post replay CSVs to infra/ops ticket.

devon: also add a rate-limited fallback route: if tenant breaches >2m trigger degraded-model routing rather than immediate eviction. need model-router flag for degraded_mode; I'll draft an API patch.

harry: add to telemetry: record every degraded_model switch with event_id and duration so billing/support can reconcile.

maris: calendar: "GPU capacity quick follow-up" 15m weekly for 6 weeks starting 2026-03-24 09:00 PDT, rotating infra oncall. invite sent.

ops-bot: Created issue infra/ops#1901 "burst_tokens + eviction-damping + reserve-auction" (assignees: devon, sylvie, harry).

maris: final ask: add a Grafana panel that flags 02:00-04:00 UTC headroom drops and shows overlapping heavy jobs. who can add it?

sylvie: i'll add the panel and an alert when avg headroom <9% for 3 intervals.

maris: thanks all. i'll consolidate owners & dates into the incident ticket and post a short customer-note template once telemetry PR lands. ping this thread when PRs are up. :white_check_mark:
